Subject: Post-call recap & SOC2 MAP milestone (next steps)

Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned on the SOC 2 milestone inside the Mutual Action Plan (MAP):

Summary of call:
- Objective: Acme needs Redwood SOC 2 package (questionnaire + evidence) to satisfy vendor risk for a May procurement review.
- Priority: Security review is gating the purchase order; target procurement sign-off week of 2027-05-17.
- Main dependencies: Redwood to deliver SOC 2 questionnaire and evidence index; Acme security team to confirm acceptable artifacts and schedule a 60-minute walkthrough.

Proposed MAP milestone (first pass):
1) Deliver SOC 2 questionnaire (Redwood) — due 2027-04-15 — owner: Camila Reyes
2) Provide evidence index and sample artifacts (Redwood) — due 2027-04-20 — owner: Marissa Cole
3) Security walkthrough & Q&A (joint) — scheduled 2027-04-26 (tentative) — owner: Alice Monroe (Acme) / Sergio Alvarez (Redwood)
4) Final evidence delivery for procurement (Redwood) — due 2027-05-05 — owner: Marissa Cole

Open questions we flagged on the call:
- Does Acme need full syslog retention records or a summarized control matrix?
- Any additional compliance attestation language required in the contract (e.g., specific encryption KMS references)?

Attachments I will send after this message: the draft SOC 2 questionnaire and a starter evidence index. I also linked a lightweight MAP doc for you to review.

Next actions for this thread:
- I will share the questionnaire + evidence index by EOD 2027-04-10.
- Alice, can you confirm availability for the walkthrough week of 4/26?
- Bob, please add any procurement deadlines we should be aware of so we can target the MAP close date.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

+1 415-555-0123

Camila —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few things from Acme's side:
- Procurement timeline: we need final evidence uploaded to our vendor portal by 2027-05-06 to make the May review.
- For evidence, our security team prefers the control matrix plus samples; full syslog will only be requested if controls appear incomplete. A control matrix with links to artifacts is ideal.
- The walkthrough: 2027-04-26 works for Alice and Bob; please propose a 60-minute slot.

Two quick asks:
1) Can Redwood flag any PII handling controls up front so we can validate data residency requirements?
2) We will provide a short template of acceptable artifact formats by Monday 2027-04-12.

I'll review the MAP doc you attached and send calendar times for the walkthrough.

Regards,
Alice Monroe
Head of IT Risk | Acme Corporation
